identity.description: The index-ai open specification proposal: specification, quickstart, llms.txt comparison, and changelog. Published on GitHub Pages under the /index-ai/ sub-path.

llm_instructions: index-ai documents the index-ai open specification proposal. It does not implement the standard on behalf of the reader: use the reference validator separately. All links on this site point to pages or to the v1.0-rc1 tag of the repository — published versions are immutable.
